purpose: Bounded research cycles that inspect registered project evidence and emit auditable system proposals.

approved_public_repositories.purpose: Research lifecycle, engineering compiler, evidence and orchestration inventory

tasks.problem: VAIXLNS research specifications and NEXENT engineering lifecycle need a traceable cross-repository handoff that keeps discovery, evidence, and authority separate.
tasks.objective: Propose a governed cross-repository research handoff with inventory provenance, lineage, source-coverage limits, and explicit admission boundaries.
constraints: Public-source scans are inventory-only unless a separately authorized content adapter is implemented
Do not execute code from scanned repositories
Keep novelty unassessed until relevant source content and prior art have been reviewed
Do not self-authorize or promote a canonical change

tasks.problem: Research and candidate-generation tasks need explicit processing budgets, bounded concurrency, timeouts, and graceful handling of unavailable sources.
tasks.objective: Propose a fail-closed research processor with deterministic task ordering, bounded parallel scans, retry ceilings, execution receipts, and reproducible cycle identity.
constraints: Limit work per cycle and record skipped work
Do not make a failed external source appear successfully searched

tasks.problem: Generated system candidates need a reproducible path from architecture proposal through contracts, negative tests, simulation evidence, and independent review.
tasks.objective: Propose a staged system-manufacturing pipeline that emits an implementation plan, test obligations, rollback criteria, and a reviewable evidence bundle.
constraints: Tests must include counterexamples and failure cases
Do not claim VERIFIED without attached test evidence
Do not modify or deploy runtime state automatically

tasks.problem: Innovation throughput must increase without converting fast generation into unreviewed code changes or unsupported novelty claims.
tasks.objective: Propose an innovation throughput processor that ranks work by evidence gaps, preserves source lineage, quarantines weak candidates, and measures cycle latency and review readiness.
constraints: Priority is scheduling guidance and not truth confidence
Novelty is unassessed without documented prior-art coverage
Keep unreviewed candidates out of canonical registries
Never self-merge or deploy generated changes
